messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "could have unpleasant withdrawal symptoms"
set: ["could have unpleasant withdrawal symptoms", "stopping suddenly can cause unpleasant withdrawal symptoms", "does not cause withdrawal symptoms", "monitor for withdrawal symptoms when discontinuing therapy", "stopping suddenly may cause increased seizures or withdrawal symptoms", "your reactions could be impaired", "this is true even if you have no symptoms", "call your doctor at once if you have these symptoms", "increase dose if symptoms have not improved after several weeks", "seek medical attention right away if you have symptoms of serotonin syndrome", "do not share with another person even if they have same symptoms", "tell your doctor if you have frequent symptoms of high blood sugar (hyperglycemia)", "sucking on the pill could irritate your mouth or throat", "seek emergency medical attention if you have symptoms such as chest pain or pressure", "do not share this medicine with another person even if they have the same symptoms", "report symptoms at injection site"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
